recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up studio portrait of a woman with dark hair and expressive eyes, framed within a wide, solid blue border. The subject rests her chin on her hands, which are draped in light blue feathers. The top section features clean, white and light blue sans-serif text against the dark blue background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject framed by a thick, uniform solid-color border
Feather texture contrasting with smooth facial features
Text aligned horizontally across the top margin
Cool color palette of blues and teals against warm skin tones
coreInvariants: High-contrast studio lighting on the face
Tight cropping on the subject's head and shoulders

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered photographic inset occupying approximately 70% of the total height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, positioned slightly above the horizontal center of the inset.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bold white text at the top, down to the subject's eyes, then following the curve of the feathers at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial solid blue border providing a heavy, formal frame.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the border; muted, naturalistic tones in the portrait; high value contrast in the typography.

composition.relationshipToImage: placed in the border above the image
placed in the border following the main title

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic hierarchy using color and scale to distinguish primary and secondary information within the same typeface family.

preserve: Color distinction between name and title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, clean aesthetic of the era.
Captures the tight tracking and geometric proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up studio portrait of a woman with dark hair and soft lighting, resting her chin on hands draped in light blue feathers. Place this image inside a large, solid cobalt blue square frame, leaving a wide margin at the top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two levels of uppercase geometric sans-serif text in the top margin. The first part should be white and large; the second part should be light blue and slightly smaller, continuing on the same line. Below this, add a small block of centered metadata text in white.

verificationChecks: Is the border a consistent solid blue?
Is the text strictly uppercase sans-serif?
Are the feathers a distinct light blue/cyan?

mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title

mustAchieve: Balanced color harmony between the blue frame and the cyan feathers

postGenerationChecks: Verify text is legible against the blue background
Ensure the photographic inset has sharp edges
Check that the skin tones appear natural under the cool lighting
Confirm the feather texture is detailed and soft
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast studio portrait with a wide, solid-color border and top-aligned geometric sans-serif typography to create a classic mid-century soul aesthetic.
